newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates ease in liquid mkt.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates ease in liquid mkt.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound eased on Monday in a more liquid private sector market to between 8-1/2 and nine percent from 8-7/8 and 9-1/4 percent on Sunday, bankers said.
One banker said he dealt at rates of 8-3/4 and 9-1/4 percent. The market is normally tight on Sunday, the beginning of the trading week.
One-week rates were also lower at between 8-3/8 and 9-1/4 percent compared to 8-7/8 and 9-1/4 percent, bankers added.
